title: External --write completes publication and then exits nonzero while formatting its success message
observed_behavior: With an absolute --output-dir outside the repository, write_outputs successfully published the complete 6,499-row baseline, CSV, and Markdown artifacts. The CLI then evaluated output_dir.relative_to(REPO_ROOT) only for its success message, raised ValueError because the external directory is not a repository descendant, and returned a nonzero process result despite the successful transaction.
expected_invariant: The explicitly supported absolute --output-dir flow must return success after a successful external ledger publication, and presentation-only path formatting must not contradict the transaction result.
root_cause: The --write success message assumes every output directory is below REPO_ROOT even though argument resolution and the non-self-referential freeze design accept absolute external output directories.
failure_scenario: Automation treats the required external freeze generation as failed, retries or withholds the ledger even though all authoritative files were already atomically written; a later command may consume the bytes while orchestration reports failure.
evidence: The external preflight command wrote a 6,499-row baseline and printed the subsequent merge/check successes, then the --write process traceback ended at output_dir.relative_to(REPO_ROOT).
Direct inspection and the following --merge-reviews/--check proved the external artifacts were complete and current; only the reporting expression failed.
Source lines 2411-2414 accept an absolute args.output_dir and immediately call relative_to(REPO_ROOT) after write_outputs returns.
existing_safeguards: subsequent --merge-reviews and --check validate the written bytes
the exception occurs after publication rather than during it
safeguard_gap: No path-label helper handles output directories outside REPO_ROOT, and no CLI test covers absolute external --output-dir with --write.
tests_present: Repository-audit unit tests cover atomic publication and external build_rows construction.
tests_missing: CLI --write to an absolute directory outside the repository returns zero and reports a stable absolute label.
recommended_remediation: Format a repository-relative label only when the resolved output is contained by REPO_ROOT; otherwise print the absolute resolved path. Add a focused CLI regression test while preserving atomic publication.
remediation_risk: low: presentation-only path formatting, but the test must prove no change to path-universe exclusion semantics
validation_rung: Focused repository-audit CLI test, full 34-test ledger suite, external write/merge/check cycle, and strict packet coverage; no real media is required.
prior_audit_relationship: New final-gate root cause discovered only when the required external non-self-referential ledger was generated; earlier in-repository output paths did not exercise it.
